import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

p = 0.7
n = 10000

samples = rng.binomial(
    n=1,
    p=p,
    size=n
)

sample_mean = samples.mean()
sample_var = samples.var()

print("Theoretical Mean:", p)
print("Sample Mean:", sample_mean)

print(
    "Theoretical Variance:",
    p * (1 - p)
)

print(
    "Sample Variance:",
    sample_var
)

import torch

from torch.distributions import Bernoulli


dist = Bernoulli(
    probs=torch.tensor(0.7)
)

samples = dist.sample(
    (10000,)
)

print(samples.shape)

print(
    "Sample Mean:",
    samples.mean().item()
)

print(
    "Sample Variance:",
    samples.var(unbiased=False).item()
)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

logits = torch.tensor([
    [2.0],
    [-1.0],
    [0.5]
])

targets = torch.tensor([
    [1.0],
    [0.0],
    [1.0]
])

criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

loss = criterion(
    logits,
    targets
)

print(loss.item())
